fact: The e-Government Agency (eGA) issued the e-Government Interoperability Framework (e-GIF), document eGA/EXT/GIF/001 version 1.0, approved by its CEO in February 2016, setting common standards and technical guidelines for Public Institutions to exchange data.

The e-Government Agency issued the e-Government Architecture Vision - Standards and Technical Guidelines (eGA/EXT/AVS/001) v1.0, approved by its CEO in November 2017, as the first of nine e-Government enterprise architecture areas, which include an interoperability framework and apply to all public institutions.
